0022600196.text: The Bulls, 1-7 overall and 0-2 at home, host the 76ers, the top team in the East at 8-1 and winners of five straight, with a 4-0 road record. Chicago has lost six straight and sits 14th in the East and 5 games back in the Central, while Philadelphia leads the Atlantic. This season the Bulls trail the series 0-1 after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia on November 2, and last season the Bulls won 2-1. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain), and Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (undisclosed) are day-to-day, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture).
